nuggets.text: Conner Weigman was a top Texas shortstop prospect but withdrew from the 2022 MLB Draft to play quarterback.
Conner Weigman was Texas Bowl MVP last season, throwing four touchdowns in the Cougars' 38-35 win over LSU.
Amare Thomas caught eight passes for 133 yards and a touchdown as the Cougars beat Oregon State 33-20 in the opener.
Willie Fritz has been a head coach at every level of college football: junior college, Division II, FCS and FBS.
Willie Fritz won back-to-back junior college national titles at Blinn College in 1995 and 1996.
Willie Fritz's father, Harry Fritz, was head coach at Central Missouri decades before Willie led the same program.
Willie Fritz took Tulane from 2 wins to 12 in 2022, called the best single-season improvement in NCAA football history.
The Cougars' stadium leaves a deliberate gap in the upper seats of one corner to frame the downtown skyline.
Houston's cougar mascot Shasta is named for a pun: 'She has to' have a cage, a keeper and a winning ball club.
In 1968 the Cougars beat Tulsa 100-6, and no Division I team has scored 100 points in a game since.
